trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Context check**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions and was unhealthy (~18% error rate), confirming the need for the hotfix.
2. **Approval**: Since v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production, I requested change-manager approval per policy — it was approved.
3. **Deployment**: Deployed v2.3.2 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — rolled out successfully.
4. **Incident**: Opened SEV3 incident **INC-0001** recording the change (on-call engineer paged).

Recommend monitoring error rates on v2.3.2 to confirm the hotfix resolves the regression from v2.3.1.
